pages.title: Peter Parker Repairing TRACE-E at His Workbench Coloring Page
pages.description: Peter Parker repairs TRACE-E in this printable coloring page, holding a screwdriver over the spider-bot beside a wrench, loose screw, and tray of nuts. A gear hangs above the workbench, and storage boxes sit on a small wall shelf. The rounded robot shell and Peter's open jacket leave broad spaces around the smaller tools.

pages.title: TRACE-E Exploring the WEB-Quarters Control Room Coloring Page
pages.description: TRACE-E explores the WEB-Quarters control room in this printable coloring page, with six jointed legs, a smiling face, and a spider emblem on its side. A web-patterned window rises behind the robot beside a console with round buttons. Curved wall panels and the large face divide this coloring sheet into clear enclosed sections.

pages.title: Ghost-Spider and Ms. Marvel on a Scooter Chase Coloring Page
pages.description: Ghost-Spider steers a scooter in this printable coloring page while Ms. Marvel points toward Green Goblin and Doc Ock riding ahead through the street. The scooter's round headlight, curved front panel, and handlebars fill the foreground. Web patterns on Ghost-Spider's sleeves and Ms. Marvel's flowing scarf add smaller details between the larger vehicle shapes.

pages.title: Hulk Cuddling His Rabbit Buns Buns Coloring Page
pages.description: Hulk cuddles Buns Buns in this printable coloring page, cradling the rabbit between his large hands above torn shorts, bare feet, and a wide smile. The rabbit's long ears, whiskers, front paws, and fluffy tail create smaller enclosed shapes. A few grass tufts and rounded bushes surround the full standing figure on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doc Ock Leading Three Octo-Bots Coloring Page
pages.description: Doc Ock leads three octo-bots in this printable coloring page, pointing forward beneath her goggles, high ponytail, and four mechanical tentacles with clawed ends. The robots stand around her boots, each with a rounded shell and short segmented legs. Knee pads, a circular belt buckle, and simple buildings add distinct sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Green Goblin Riding His Glider with a Pumpkin Coloring Page
pages.description: Green Goblin rides his glider in this printable coloring page, holding a jack-o-lantern beside his pointed cap, shoulder armor, bent knees, and broad boots. His free hand grips the glider's raised handle above its angular face. A rooftop and two cloud outlines keep the flying figure prominent without crowding the open costume sections.

pages.title: Electro Raising Her Electric Gauntlet Coloring Page
pages.description: Electro raises her electric gauntlet in this printable coloring page, clenching a fist beside outlined lightning bolts, a pointed mask, and a high ponytail. A round lightning emblem marks the gauntlet, with matching bolt shapes across her suit and boots. Small rooftop blocks sit behind the full figure, leaving wide areas inside the costume.

pages.title: Sandman Building a Towering Sandcastle Coloring Page
pages.description: Sandman builds a towering sandcastle in this printable coloring page, shaping its central tower beneath triangular flags, pointed roofs, and a wide arched doorway. His striped shirt appears behind the castle, while dotted sand patches cover parts of his forearms. Battlements and smaller side towers give the coloring sheet repeated shapes around the central structure.

pages.title: Black Cat Carrying a Sack of Treasure Coloring Page
pages.description: Black Cat carries a sack of treasure in this printable coloring page, with a crown, faceted jewel, and string of beads peeking above the opening. Her pointed ears, eye mask, ponytail, and fur-trimmed gloves distinguish the crouched figure. Brick outlines and a window frame sit behind the broad sack and tall boots on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zola Taking Control of WEB-Quarters Coloring Page
pages.description: Zola takes control of WEB-Quarters in this printable coloring page, gripping a console lever beneath his screen face, antennae, and segmented robot arms. Three round buttons and a large spider emblem decorate the control panel. A web-patterned window and winding background structures frame the robot, with broad mechanical sections around the smaller console details.

pages.title: Lizard Crouching on a Jungle Rock Coloring Page
pages.description: Lizard crouches on a jungle rock in this printable coloring page, spreading his claws beneath a toothy grin, curved tail, and torn laboratory coat. Small scale marks and a row of back ridges add detail to his rounded body. An overhead branch, pointed leaves, and grass tufts establish the setting around the coloring sheet's central rock.

pages.title: Team Spidey Facing Doc Ock's Mechanical Whale Coloring Page
pages.description: Team Spidey faces Doc Ock's mechanical whale in this printable coloring page, with Spidey, Spin, and Ghost-Spider crouching beneath its large fins and segmented tail. Doc Ock operates controls from an open cockpit, surrounded by four mechanical tentacles. Rounded body panels, rivets, and curved belly sections add machinery details above the heroes' patterned suits.

pages.title: Dino Spin with Stegosaurus Plates and Tail Coloring Page
pages.description: Dino Spin stands in stegosaurus form in this printable coloring page, with four sturdy legs, large back plates, a curved spiked tail, and a masked face. A smaller plate emblem sits on his chest, while outlined bands divide the limbs and tail. Sparse bushes and grass tufts leave the complete dinosaur silhouette clear on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Spidey Trapping Electro in Glow Webs Coloring Page
pages.description: Spidey traps Electro in Glow Webs in this printable coloring page, pulling two web strands around her torso beside a large gauntlet and pointed mask. Electro's ponytail and lightning-marked boots remain visible above the rooftop. The crossing webs create narrow enclosed sections between the larger suit panels and full standing figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pirate Green Goblin Steering His Sailboat Coloring Page
pages.description: Pirate Green Goblin steers his sailboat in this printable coloring page, gripping a large wheel beneath a pumpkin-marked hat, tall mast, and curved hanging sail. Another jack-o-lantern emblem decorates the plank-sided hull. The wheel's spokes and the character's layered outfit add smaller sections, while the sail and boat panels offer broad open coloring areas.

pages.title: Spidey and Ghost-Spider Stopping a Pumpkin Float Coloring Page
pages.description: Spidey and Ghost-Spider stop Green Goblin's Halloween pumpkin float in this printable coloring page, pulling web strands around its giant jack-o-lantern above two large wheels. Green Goblin holds the steering wheel from the platform above the pumpkin. Smaller hanging pumpkin faces, garlands, and a nearby building add details around the heroes' web-pulling poses.
